title: Coral and the Colony
author: Ada Dravenmoor
blurb: Felix Winterbourne, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
